text:
Maya Patel: quick idea 9— introduce a "preflight-mini" step for any compact/quantized variant. tiny, deterministic checks to avoid garbage going to canary.

Kevin Li: sounds useful. what specifically would it cover vs full bench?

Maya Patel: minimal checks only: tokenizer sanity, kv-cache shape, a micro golden set for output stability, and short-seq P95 latency smoke. goal: <120s wall time.

Amir Khan: suggest metrics: top-1 stability on 25 probes, mean logit cosine < 0.15, and max-p95-latency-ms 400. Fail if any 2 of 3 checks fail.

Olga Jensen: ops ask: run on the same runtime binary stack we ship (quant libs + kernels) to avoid false failures. Also run once per target runtime (cuda/xla/cpu-emu) in parallel.

Sam Ortiz: add me on the observability side. we should emit a compact result blob with labels: variant_id, manifest_hash, failure_reasons, and a link to raw outputs.

Maya Patel: agreed. rough config example I sketched:
```
preflight-mini:
  probes: 25
  top1_flip_threshold: 3
  logit_cosine_threshold: 0.15
  max_p95_ms: 400
  runtimes: [cuda,xla,cpu-emu]
  kv_shape_check: true
  tokenizer_checksum: true
  timeout_s: 120
```

Kevin Li: how do we avoid noisy gates during infra rollouts? a kernel bump could make many variants fail.

Olga Jensen: add a cluster-wide "preflight-mode" toggle: strict | advisory | off. During infra work we flip to advisory globally. Also keep a short failure history per variant id to suppress one-off flakes.

Amir Khan: we should implement a probation state machine: first fail = advisory + auto-schedule full bench + notify owner; second consecutive fail within 48h = block ingest for that variant. Allow explicit owner override label "platform-experiment".

Maya Patel: love the probation approach. also propose auto-fallback policy: if preflight fails after deployment (canary/initial traffic), route traffic to the parent stable snapshot and mark variant as quarantined until owner fixes.

Sam Ortiz: artifact storage: MiniBenchBot upload path s3://redwood-mini-preflight/<model>/<variant>/<ts>/ with probes.ndjson, summary.json, env.txt. Keep 30d retention by default.

MiniBenchBot: will implement upload and attach presigned URL to the ingest event. will include a short human-readable diff and a deterministic seed in summary.json.

Kevin Li: implementation plan: I'll add the k8s job + pipeline hook to trigger preflight-mini on variant publish. job should use a small compute class (1 GPU or cpu-emu) and run parallel per runtime target.

Amir Khan: i'll ensure the harness uses identical tokenization and quant libs as serving. i'll also build deterministic seeding for probes to make comparisons stable.

Olga Jensen: i'll add the cluster toggle and a lightweight dashboard (counts of advisory vs blocking failures) plus a runbook for triage. retention policy: 30d default, extended on request.

Maya Patel: action items recap:
- add preflight-mini job to onboarding pipeline (blocking for compact variants)
- define config schema in manifest (thresholds, runtimes, timeout)
- probation state machine: 1 advisory then block on repeat within window
- MiniBenchBot artifact upload with 30d retention
- fallback routing to parent snapshot for post-deploy failures
- cluster-level preflight-mode toggle and runbook
- RFC update with examples and state diagrams (Maya)

Sam Ortiz: I'll draft the event schema for observability and a short alerting policy.

Kevin Li: I'll open the pipeline PR this week.

Amir Khan: prototyping harness now, will share the probe set in a gist.

Olga Jensen: will wire the toggle and dashboard; ping me if you want early access to the degraded-mode tests.

Maya Patel: thanks team. will follow up with RFC link and tag owners. :raised_hands:
